messages:
zoe: hey team — quick q while i'm getting my first PR together. what's our preferred PR size? i'm leaning small but worried about churn.
alex: small + focused. 200-400 lines max unless it's a refactor. smaller makes reviews faster and less context cleanup :+1:
jamie: also add a tiny description and a 'why' section in the PR body. reviewers skim for intent more than diffs.
zoe: got it. branch naming? i'm using `feature/zoe/first-pr` — ok?
olivia: yep that's fine. convention is `feature/yourname/<short-desc>` or `fix/owner/issue` for small patches. keep it <= 3 hyphen segments.
matt: for commits, we follow conventional-ish style: short subj (50 chars), blank line, body if needed. e.g.
```
Add telemetry for model-inference latency

Includes a small helper and unit tests. Keeps existing metric names.
```
alex: CI note: if unit tests flake, mention `ci-bot rerun` in a comment. ci-bot: reruns require at most 2 attempts before case owner investigates.
zoe: who do I request for reviews for a platform-level change? runtime vs api?
jamie: runtime changes -> @alex or @matt. API/SDK -> @olivia. If unsure, tag both and put a short blurb about impact on infra.
olivia: also add the label `needs-design-review` if there are API shape changes, otherwise `needs-review` is fine.
zoe: any linting/hooks i should know about locally before pushing?
matt: run `make preflight` — it runs linters, fmt, and the small static checks. if preflight fails CI will too, but better to fix locally.
zoe: how do we do canary or staged rollouts for bigger changes?
alex: create a canary deployment PR in `eng-releases` with the rollout plan and smoke tests. include a rollback plan in the PR body.
jamie: tiny tip — add a short checklist at bottom of PR with things like `- [ ] changelog`, `- [ ] tests added`, `- [ ] e2e smoke run ok`.
zoe: perfect, thanks. last q: do we squash merges or preserve commit history?
olivia: squash on small feature PRs. preserve history for long-lived or multi-author work — add a note to the merge message.
zoe: awesome, i'll open one shortly. ping me if you'd like to pair on review.
alex: happy to pair. ping @alex when it's up.
matt: welcome again! :tada:
